_doc: Real-data retrieval test. Queries = the requirements of the real LinkedIn offer data/jobs/offers/it_support_specialist.txt, as the Matching agent would search them. CVs = the 10 IT CVs of the Kaggle Resume Dataset most similar to the offer (TF-IDF). Relevance is a SILVER label: a chunk is relevant if it matches the requirement's regex pattern. Patterns were written by Claude and must be checked by two team members; a (CV, requirement) pair with no match anywhere in the CV is excluded from the metrics. Because labels come from keywords, they favour lexical retrieval (TF-IDF): keep that bias in mind when comparing with bge-m3.

requirements.query: A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum of 1 year experience providing technical support
Minimum of 2 years in a customer service position
At least one industry certification such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Net+, or Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator (MCSA)
Remote support of cloud-based solutions such as Office365 and Azure
Tier 1 troubleshooting of WAN and LAN connectivity, firewalls, routers, and Wi-Fi
Service board triage: assign incoming service tickets and create service tickets
Experience with Active Directory and Azure Active Directory environments
Basic understanding of Windows OS and MacOS
